base_record_snapshot.lesson: A verification pipeline's RESOLUTION layer fails silently ahead of its CLASSIFICATION layer, and the two defect classes compound into a false GENUINE. review-close-check.py has three prior verifier-split chapters, all working the classification axis (which reason-code a finding earns). Tic 679 surfaced the layer beneath: if promoted_to never resolves to a file at all, NO classification axis can fire, and the finding falls through as GENUINE-missing for an inscription that is demonstrably present and executing. Two independent resolution defects, both empirically reproduced: (A) ORDER-OF-OPERATIONS — _collect_targets calls _split_compound_targets on the RAW promoted_to before scope-hint stripping, so a parenthetical scope hint that legitimately contains ' + ' is fractured mid-parenthesis; the resulting component carries an UNCLOSED paren, and _SCOPE_HINT_RE (anchored r'^(.*?)\s+\(.*\)$', requiring a closing paren at end-of-string) then cannot strip it, so the mangled string is passed to the filesystem as a path. Normalization must precede decomposition: strip scope hints FIRST, split compounds SECOND, or split only on ' + ' occurring OUTSIDE parentheses. (B) RUNG-AMBIGUOUS RELATIVE PATH — a relative promoted_to in a cross-rung federation record does not declare WHICH rung root it anchors to. _read_target/_target_exists try the federation root, a federation-basename-prefix fallback, and an auto-memory fallback, but have NO domain-root fallback; every target recorded relative to the CGG domain root (cgg-runtime/..., cgg-ledger/...) is therefore unresolvable. This REFINES 'relative paths anchor at zone root, never cwd' (t662): in a multi-rung federation there is more than one zone root, so 'anchor at zone root' is underdetermined — the record must either carry a rung-qualified path or the resolver must walk the declared rung chain. MEASURED BLAST RADIUS over the 641 promoted rows: defect A affects 4, defect B affects 6, overlap 1. The overlap is the whole point — 8 of the 9 singly-affected CPRs are rescued by a surviving axis (provenance-comment index, cpr_id literal, lesson snippet), so each defect alone stays invisible; only cpr_mandate_failure_protocol_ledger_crosscheck_ops_tic677, which trips BOTH, escalates to GENUINE. A verifier whose redundant axes mask its resolution failures reports its own blind spot as the system's defect, and the false GENUINE lands on whichever record happens to trip two defects at once — an arbitrary victim, not a signal.
